name: Image-Space Particle Splatting for Density Field Construction
aliases: Image-Space Volume Visualization for Dynamic Particle Simulations
definition: A method to visualize dynamic particle simulations by reconstructing a density field in image space using splatting and ray casting, avoiding the resolution limits of object-space uniform grids.
summary: Image-Space Particle Splatting constructs density fields directly in the image buffer via multiple render targets, avoiding 3D grid construction to preserve sharp features and reduce memory usage.
